research.name: Fire
research.description: Warmth, light and cooked food. Known from the start.

research.name: Stone Tools
research.description: Knapped blades and scrapers. Known from the start.

research.name: Foraging
research.description: Knowing which plants feed and which harm. Known from the start.

research.name: Spears
research.description: Hafted stone points. Unlocks the Hunters' Camp.

research.name: Tracking
research.description: Reading trails and seasons. Hunting yield +30%.

research.name: Hide Working
research.description: Scraping, curing and stitching hides. Unlocks the Hide Tent and Hide Worker.

research.name: Food Preservation
research.description: Drying and smoking. Unlocks the Drying Rack; all food spoils 15% slower.

research.name: Fishing
research.description: Weirs, lines and spears for fish. Unlocks the Fishing Spot.

research.name: Herbal Knowledge
research.description: Plants that heal. Unlocks the Herbalist, the first health service.

research.name: Storytelling
research.description: Knowledge passed on around the fire. Elders produce 30% more knowledge.

research.name: Kinship
research.description: Families care for each other's children. Births +25%, happiness +5%.

research.name: Seed Gathering
research.description: Noticing which seeds sprout where. Gathering yield +15%.

research.name: Farming
research.description: Planting and tending crops. Key research for the Agricultural Age.

research.name: Tribes
research.description: Families bound into one people with shared ways. Key research for the Agricultural Age.

research.name: Animal Husbandry
research.description: Penned animals for meat, hides and milk.

research.name: Irrigation
research.description: Channels from the river to the fields.

research.name: Pottery
research.description: Fired clay vessels. Better storage; first goods.

research.name: Weaving
research.description: Woven cloth from plant fibre.

research.name: Healing
research.description: The Healer's Hut, health tier 1.

research.name: Shamanism
research.description: The Shaman's Hut: research tier 2 and the faith need.

research.name: Tribal Law
research.description: The Tribal Council and first laws (food sharing, disputes settled by elders).

research.name: Masonry
research.description: Dressed stone walls and foundations.

research.name: Barter
research.description: Organised exchange of goods between households.

research.name: Writing
research.description: Marks that keep words. Key research for the Bronze Age.

research.name: Bronze Working
research.description: Smelting copper and tin. Key research for the Bronze Age.
